items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Duet Club is the Riverside of Roman between Perdida and Graff. Perdida and Graff.

ctx.x: And the Black Brown was a good drama.
The Duet Club is the Riverside of Roman between Perdida and Graff. Perdida and Graff. Okay, now a house. Remember anything about the club, the members, or what happened? Did they just die out, or?
Well, they have some of the members around there yet. Some of the members around by Jim's place. That's the little ballroom on Perdida between Roman and Bollipop. But the club isn't active.
